items.question: What kernel shape does HexaNet use instead of square kernels?
items.reference_answer: Hexagonal convolution kernels with six equidistant neighbours.

relevant.phrase: hexagonal convolution kernels with six equidistant neighbours

items.question: What accuracy did HexaNet reach on EuroSAT compared with ResNet-18?

relevant.phrase: reaches an accuracy of 96.4%, compared with 94.1% for ResNet-18

items.question: What are the limitations of HexaNet?
items.reference_answer: It needs a resampling step that raises preprocessing time, was tested only on optical imagery, and used a single random seed.

relevant.phrase: requires a resampling step that increases preprocessing time
